english: Let $OABC$ be a tetrahedron with $\overrightarrow{OA}=\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{OB}=\overrightarrow{b}$ and $\overrightarrow{OC}=\overrightarrow{c}$, where $|\overrightarrow{a}|=2$, $|\overrightarrow{b}|=3$, $|\overrightarrow{c}|=6$,

Let $P$, $Q$ and $R$ be the points such that $\overrightarrow{OP}=\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}$, $\overrightarrow{OQ}=\overrightarrow{b}\times\overrightarrow{c}$ and $\overrightarrow{OR}=\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{a}$. Then the volume of the tetrahedron $OPQR$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $OABC$ एक चतुष्फलक है जिसमें $\overrightarrow{OA}=\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{OB}=\overrightarrow{b}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{OC}=\overrightarrow{c}$ हैं, जहाँ $|\overrightarrow{a}|=2$, $|\overrightarrow{b}|=3$, $|\overrightarrow{c}|=6$,

हैं। माना कि $P$, $Q$ तथा $R$ ऐसे बिन्दु हैं कि $\overrightarrow{OP}=\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}$, $\overrightarrow{OQ}=\overrightarrow{b}\times\overrightarrow{c}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{OR}=\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{a}$ हैं। तब चतुष्फलक $OPQR$ का आयतन ______ है।
solution: $\overrightarrow{a}\times(\overrightarrow{b}\times\overrightarrow{c})=(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c})\overrightarrow{b}-(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b})\overrightarrow{c}$; $\overrightarrow{b},\overrightarrow{c}$ are non-collinear ($OABC$ is a tetrahedron), so $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=4$, $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=2$
solution_full: Since $OABC$ is a tetrahedron, $\overrightarrow{a},\overrightarrow{b},\overrightarrow{c}$ are non-coplanar; in particular any two of them are non-collinear.

Vector triple product: $\overrightarrow{a}\times(\overrightarrow{b}\times\overrightarrow{c})=(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c})\overrightarrow{b}-(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b})\overrightarrow{c}$. Comparing with $4\overrightarrow{b}-2\overrightarrow{c}$ (coefficients are unique because $\overrightarrow{b},\overrightarrow{c}$ are non-collinear): $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=4$ and $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=2$.

originality_note: New: the dot products of the edge vectors of a tetrahedron are not given; they are encoded in two vector triple product identities, then the tetrahedron spanned by the face-normal cross products is measured through [a x b, b x c, c x a] = [a b c]^2 and the dot-product determinant (way 5). Closest known: [a x b, b x c, c x a] = [a b c]^2 as a textbook identity; volume of a tetrahedron from edge lengths and angles. Different because: three results must be chained and the data come in triple-product form.

concept_use.Questions based on tetrahedron: Volume of tetrahedron OPQR as one sixth of the scalar triple product of its edge vectors from O.
concept_use.Application of Scalar triple product: [a x b, b x c, c x a] = [a b c]^2 and [a b c]^2 as the determinant of dot products.
concept_use.Application of Vector triple product: Expanding a x (b x c) and b x (c x a) gives a.c = 4, a.b = 2 and b.c = -3.

stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, plane, vector and parameter is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked consistency of the data by constructing explicit vectors with these lengths and dot products (Cholesky factor of the dot-product matrix) and verifying both identities. Changed: wrote the two identities on a display line for readability.
key_step: Decoding the dot products from the triple product identities and using [a x b, b x c, c x a] = [a b c]^2 with the Gram determinant.
justification: Three standard results chained (vector triple product expansion, square of a box product, dot-product determinant) with exact arithmetic and no options; each is known, the chain is not routine. Close to 2021-P1-Q19 (L3), which also recovers a volume from dot-product data.
